title.en: Turn Today’s Sprint into a guided game and unify every Play entry
title.zh: 将今日速成升级为引导式游戏并统一全部边玩边学入口

purpose.en: Make Today’s Sprint teach each word and sentence through answer, feedback, and speech interactions while every Home and menu Play entry opens the same complete six-activity hub.
purpose.zh: 让今日速成通过答题、反馈和跟读逐步教授每个词与句子，并让首页及菜单的边玩边学入口统一进入完整六项 Play 页面。

en: Present each Sprint vocabulary item as a flippable SmartCard-style card with four meaning choices.
Show immediate correct or incorrect feedback and reveal the right answer after a mistake.
Automatically model pronunciation and start repeat-after-me when the shared preference is enabled.
Follow vocabulary with sentence read-aloud, meaning selection, listening word assembly, writing word assembly, and final speaking.
Place anonymous Free Trial as the sixth and final Play tile.
zh: 将每个速成词汇显示为可翻面的 SmartCard 式卡片，并提供四个词义选项。
答题后立即显示正确或错误反馈，答错时明确展示正确答案。
全局跟读开启时自动示范发音并开始识别学习者跟读。
词汇后依次完成句子跟读、选义、听力组句、写作组句和最终口语。
将匿名免费试学固定为 Play 第六张、最后一张卡。
匿名及登录用户今日速成

en: Remove the duplicate three-card Play panel from Home and route the Home button directly to the canonical six-tile Play hub.
Record per-word answer evidence and score vocabulary correctness server-side while retaining compatibility with earlier runs.
Add speech recovery states that never trap learners when browser recognition is unavailable or silent.
Extend regression tests for the unified Home route, final Free Trial tile, flip-card interaction, answer feedback, speech, and sentence builders.
zh: 删除首页重复的三卡 Play 面板，并让首页按钮直接进入唯一的六卡 Play 页面。
记录逐词答案证据并由服务器计算词汇正确率，同时兼容既有速成记录。
加入语音恢复状态，在浏览器不支持识别或未听到语音时不会卡住学习者。
扩展回归测试，覆盖首页统一跳转、最后一张免费试学、翻卡、答题反馈、跟读和组句。

en: Run the verified production build, sensitive-data scan, artifact validation, TypeScript, and all 328 repository tests.
Use real Chrome and Safari to verify Home Play opens all six activities and Free Trial is last.
Complete an anonymous production Sprint through vocabulary flip and answer feedback, repeat-after-me recovery, all sentence stages, speaking, and the final sign-up reminder.
zh: 执行正式构建、敏感数据扫描、产物验证、TypeScript 与全部 328 项仓库测试。
使用真实 Chrome 与 Safari 验证首页边玩边学进入全部六项，且免费试学位于最后。
在生产环境匿名完成一次速成，覆盖词汇翻卡与答题反馈、跟读恢复、全部句子阶段、口语及最终注册提醒。

en: A genuine pronunciation score still requires real learner microphone speech; silence remains an explicit zero-score path rather than fabricated evidence.
zh: 真实发音评分仍需要学习者通过麦克风发声；静音时明确计为零分，不会伪造语音证据。

en: This is a SmartLingo-specific learning-game release and does not change other portfolio sites.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属学习游戏发布，不改变其他站点。
